page.overview:
Who is Boron?

Boron was eldest son of Baran, grandson of Bëor, and had a younger brother, Baranor. He was the third chieftain of the House of Bëor. He was married to an unnamed woman, with whom he had at least two children, Boromir and Belegor. Boromir would later became the first Lord of Ladros.
